name: mcp-checkup
description: Fix my MCP connection and explain missing or failing tools from the configs, traces and files I provide. Review Claude Code, Codex and agent SDK settings; get a minimal repair and a clear verification report. Pasted material needs no setup. Optional live checks use an existing trusted client and documented read-only tools.
